en_clean.config: clean/test + other/test, first utterances of evenly spaced speakers, 3 consecutive utterances per speaker turn
en_clean.note: long-form multi-speaker concatenation (build_longform); speaker turns known

en_talks.config: test + validation talks of at most 10 minutes (whole talks, no cutting)
en_talks.note: lower-case, unpunctuated reference; single speaker per item

en_accents.config: test, one block of consecutive utterances (one conversation) from each of several shards, IGNORE_TIME_SEGMENT_IN_SCORING dropped
en_accents.note: dialogues of non-native / regional English speakers; meta.accent per item

en_business.config: chunked/test, a contiguous window of one earnings call per shard
en_business.note: segments containing <inaudible>/<unk> tags are dropped; gaps between segments capped at 1 s; cased and punctuated verbatim reference

en_meeting.config: sdm/test, a window of one meeting each (single distant microphone), segments placed on the real timeline
en_meeting.note: diarizers-community/ami has the speaker turns but no transcript, so the transcribed edinburghcstr/ami segments supply both; only transcribed speech is present (untranscribed gaps are silence); overlapped speech is kept

es_fleurs.note: reference is raw_transcription (cased, punctuated); every sentence is a different speaker, so speaker turns are null

es_mls.config: spanish test, 3 consecutive utterances per speaker turn
es_mls.note: audiobooks; lower-case unpunctuated reference; speaker turns known

es_dialects.source: ylacombe/google-chilean-spanish, google-colombian-spanish, google-argentinian-spanish (the OpenSLR 71/72/61 crowdsourced Google recordings)
es_dialects.config: train, female and male configs, consecutive utterances
es_dialects.note: OpenSLR 73/74/75 (Peruvian, Puerto Rican, Venezuelan) mirrors are gated: see gaps

en_noise.source: derived from the en_clean test-clean items
en_noise.config: white / pink / babble noise (babble = 6 other en_clean items) at 0, 5, 10 dB SNR; one noise type and SNR per item
en_noise.note: paired with the clean items: same reference, split inherited from the source item

en_phone.source: derived from the en_clean test-clean items
en_phone.config: phone_band: 300-3400 Hz band limit, 8 kHz mu-law round trip, back at 16 kHz

nospeech.source: synthetic silence / room tone / white noise + ashraq/esc50 ambient scenes
nospeech.config: 30 clips x 20 s: 5 digital silence, 5 room tone, 10 white noise at -40..-20 dBFS, 10 ESC-50 ambient scenes (4 clips of one non-human category each)
nospeech.note: reference is the empty string; ESC-50 has no music category, so there is no music clip

gaps.code_switching: no es-en code-switching slice: BrunoHays/Bangor-Miami-Spanish-English-Corpus is the only ungated corpus found, but it ships whole 30 min conversations with CHAT-annotated transcripts (xxx, www, &=laugh, overlap codes) and no timestamps, so there is no trustworthy reference that can be cut to item length
gaps.nospeech_music: ESC-50 has no music category, so the nospeech slice has silence, room tone, white noise and ambient scenes only
gaps.es_dialects:peruvian: rcastrovexler/openslr-slr73-peruvian-spanish is gated (auto approval) and HF_TOKEN is not set
gaps.es_dialects:puerto_rican: rcastrovexler/openslr-slr74-puertorican-spanish is gated (auto approval) and HF_TOKEN is not set
gaps.es_dialects:venezuelan: rcastrovexler/openslr-slr75-venezuelan-spanish is gated (auto approval) and HF_TOKEN is not set
